title: openOODA Standard Library
content:
## What it is

The openOODA standard library. The collections, math, fs, net, science, and security primitives you import into your openOODA programs.

## Install

```sh
opm install openOODA/std
```

The std package refuses to run if the installed ooda toolchain is outside the declared range.

## Surface

The 8 functional domains:

| Domain | Scope |
|--------|-------|
| `app` | Application primitives: UI, I/O orchestration |
| `core` | Foundational types: `Option`, `Result`, `List`, arithmetic |
| `fs` | Filesystem operations under `&FsReadCap` / `&FsWriteCap` |
| `hw` | Hardware abstraction: SIMD, accelerators, low-level primitives |
| `meta` | Reflection, AST inspection, tooling primitives |
| `net` | Network operations under `&NetCap` (TCP, UDP, bind) |
| `science` | Hard-science primitives: math, physics, chem, bio, AI, economics |
| `sec` | Capability security: OCap tokens, Landlock, HMAC, taint tracking |
